FAQS.TITLE: Q & A
FAQS.INTRO: Here are some answers to the questions we think you might have. If we missed something, just let us know!
FAQS.A_RSVP_DEADLINE: Please let us know if you can make it by July 31st, 2026. This helps us plan the food and seating!
FAQS.A_DRESSCODE:
We would love for you to dress up with us! Feel free to bring plenty of color - there are zero restrictions (yes, even white is totally fine). If you want to go all out with your outfit, please do!

A quick footwear tip: The Klausenbauernhof is an old, historic farm. To stay comfortable on your feet, we'd recommend leaving thin stiletto heels at home.

Need some ideas? Check out our inspiration collage here.
FAQS.Q_PLUS_ONE: Can I bring a plus one?
FAQS.A_PLUS_ONE: Our goal is to keep the day as intimate as possible. We can therefore unfortunately not accomodate a plus one.
FAQS.A_KIDS: Yes, we love your little ones! Please put a note in the RSVP so we can plan accordingly.
FAQS.A_GIFTS: A contribution to our honeymoon fund would be appreciated.
FAQS.A_TRANSPORT: Yes, the venue has some parking spots. You can leave your car there overnight if you decide to take a taxi home.
FAQS.Q_ACCOMODATION: Can we sleep at the venue?
FAQS.A_ACCOMODATION: There are spaces for your camping-vans or tents. Please let us know, if you're planning to stay at the venue.
FAQS.A_FLIGHTS: The most convenient international airports are Frankfurt (FRA), Zurich (ZRH), and Munich (MUC). All of them offer train connections into the Black Forest, or you can easily rent a car from there. If you need any further information or help with your travel plans, please feel free to reach out to us!
FAQS.Q_TENT_RENTAL: Can I camp at the venue if I don't own a tent?
FAQS.A_TENT_RENTAL: Yes, absolutely! If you would love to camp on-site but don't have your own gear, just let us know. We can easily arrange and organize tents and equipment for you.
